articleTitle: Survey of major load balancing algorithms in distributed system
publicationTitle: 2015 Information Technologies in Innovation Business Conference (ITIB)
abstract: The classification of the most used load balancing algorithms in distributed systems (including cloud technology, cluster systems, grid systems) is described. Comparative analysis of types of the load balancing algorithms is conducted in accordance with the classification, the advantages and drawbacks of each type of the algorithms are shown. Performance indicators characterizing each algorithm are indicated.

articleTitle: Automatized technique for three-dimensional reconstruction of cranial implant based on symmetry
publicationTitle: 2015 Information Technologies in Innovation Business Conference (ITIB)
abstract: Currently, reconstruction of cranial implants using tomography study is necessary. The work is dedicated to the automation of the process of cranial implant reconstruction. We propose a set of image processing operations at three-dimensional reconstruction of cranial prosthesis using symmetry.

articleTitle: Detecting human driver's physiological stress and emotions using sophisticated one-person cockpit vehicle simulator
publicationTitle: 2015 Information Technologies in Innovation Business Conference (ITIB)
abstract: Emotions and stress play a significant role in the genesis of car accidents and it is believed that the immediate history of an accident is characterized by conditions such as anxiety, nervousness, distraction or similar emotions. This paper briefly describes how the Transportation Informatics Research Group at the University of Klagenfurt uses biometric devices to measure physiological signals, which are then processed for emotion- and stress detection in various real-driving conditions. Core of this research is a sophisticated driving simulator that is used to provoke/induce stress and emotions within a controlled and safe laboratory setup.

articleTitle: Reinvention of the cardiovascular diseases prevention and prediction due to ubiquitous convergence of mobile apps and machine learning
publicationTitle: 2015 Information Technologies in Innovation Business Conference (ITIB)
abstract: The paradigm change from delayed interventional to Predictive, Preventive and Personalized Medicine is a leading global challenge in the 21st century. Ubiquitous convergence of mobile applications, new intelligent sensors and machine learning methods make possible creation of new generation personalized automatic healthcare monitoring and pathologies detection systems. These systems will help to make platforms for more effective treatments tailored to the person, that is considered as the “medicine of the future”. Implementation of these latest trends in medicine will make it possible to detect health deterioration remotely and will avoid millions of hospitalizations costing billions of dollars in the world every year. In the article the problem of cardiovascular diseases and the state of healthcare industry is described and general architecture of automatic system for heart pathologies detection is proposed.

articleTitle: The intelligent system for diagnosing breast cancers based on image analysis
publicationTitle: 2015 Information Technologies in Innovation Business Conference (ITIB)
abstract: Cytological (CI) and histological images (HI) of separate cells and cells groups are used to diagnose breast cancer. We propose an approach that combines computer vision algorithms and intelligent processing of images (fuzzy knowledge base). We also have researched several types of breast cancer and developed a database of CI and HI. On the base of a database an intellectual system of breast cancer diagnosing is developed.

Author Keywords: breast cancer cytological and histological images

articleTitle: Methods of automated classification based on wavelet-transform for automated medical diagnostics
publicationTitle: 2015 Information Technologies in Innovation Business Conference (ITIB)
abstract: Investigation into the methods of classification with training for determination of separating surfaces coefficients using optimization methods based on wavelet-transform with and without constraints (in the form of inequalities) is carried out. Recommendations are offered for choice of optimization method for classification in automated medical diagnostics systems with regard to the peculiarities of the phase in which classification is performed. These recommendations make it possible to justify the choice of versions of the method for the optimum search at classification depending on the stage of training (additional training) of the automated system and, as a rule, conflicting requirements on speed and accuracy of classification in a particular.

articleTitle: Algorithm of matching of microobjects with different shapes
publicationTitle: 2015 Information Technologies in Innovation Business Conference (ITIB)
abstract: One of the most significant characteristic features of digital histological images is changing of the form of microobjects (cells) of the same class. The requirement to corresponding points is the stability of their position on the contour, i.e. invariance of their position during rotation, translation. The proposed algorithm of determining the corresponding points on the basis of the central moments is better during translation and rotation transformations. For comparing algorithms the evaluation of symmetric difference between matched regions is used.

articleTitle: Forecasting of airfare prices using time series
publicationTitle: 2015 Information Technologies in Innovation Business Conference (ITIB)
abstract: Airline ticket purchase timing is a strategic problem that requires both historical data and domain knowledge to be solved consistently. Even with some historical information (often a feature of modern travel reservation web sites), it is difficult for consumers to make true cost-minimizing decisions. As product prices become increasingly available on the World Wide Web, consumers attempt to understand how corporations vary these prices over time. However, corporations change the prices based on proprietary algorithms and hidden variables. This work is devoted to the analysis of time series forecasting methods on the example of air tickets forecasting prices. Then, that information it is planned to build a system that will help customers to make purchasing decisions by forecasting how air ticket prices will evolve in the future.

articleTitle: Plaque rupture - Wave approach and resonance hypothesis
publicationTitle: 2015 Information Technologies in Innovation Business Conference (ITIB)
abstract: Sudden heart attacks and cerebral strokes remain one of the primary causes of mortality and morbidity in the developed world. These acute cerebral and cardiac ischemic events (acute vascular syndromes) are commonly associated with a rupture of an atherosclerotic plaque in a large artery and subsequent thrombosis. Thus, great attention of vascular physicians is being given to predicting a plaque rupture. Nevertheless, there are grave shortcomings of the current approach to a rupture and its predictions. This study, on the background of the plaque rupture paradigm summary, presents a new interpretation of a plaque rupture using a wave approach and the resonance hypothesis that a rupture is caused by the flow induced nonlinear resonance of a plaque. To support the hypothesis the waveforms of plaque surface micrometer vibrations in a wide frequency range from 20 Hz up to 500 Hz obtained by means of finite elements (FE) and flow-structure interaction (FSI) simulation are introduced for the first time. The vibration analysis, evidence of its nonlinearity and comparison with the published data are proposed.

articleTitle: The methods of adaptation in computer-based training systems
publicationTitle: 2015 Information Technologies in Innovation Business Conference (ITIB)
abstract: Various questions of creation of integrated development environment for computer training systems are considered in the given paper. The information technologies that can be used for creating of the integrated development environment are described. Different didactic aspects of realization of such systems are analyzed. Some ways to improve the efficiency and quality of learning process with computer training systems for distance education are pointed out.

articleTitle: Specifics of organizing and standardizing innovative labour in information economy
publicationTitle: 2015 Information Technologies in Innovation Business Conference (ITIB)
abstract: Existing methods of standardizing innovative labour were considered. Suggestions for improvements in standardizing management labour were provided. The core and content of the work by innovative activities were defined. The methods of standardizing were determined depending on innovative labour operations.

articleTitle: Technology for determining of students adaptive capabilities
publicationTitle: 2015 Information Technologies in Innovation Business Conference (ITIB)
abstract: This paper considers the question of determining the adaptive capabilities of the student's organism under stress using modern information technologies. Mathematical models for assessing of the regulatory and adaptive status and integrated assessment of stress resistance of students were the basis in the presented technologies. These models have been synthesized by the result of statistical data analysis of functional and psychological research of a students organism state. Indicators have been identified that could be markers of increased psychological stress among students of different forms of education (distance and full-time).

articleTitle: User identification problems on DSP side in terms of advertising RTB auctions
publicationTitle: 2015 Information Technologies in Innovation Business Conference (ITIB)
abstract: Success of real-time bidding (RTB) and advertising campaigns depends on efficient and precise user identification, audience targeting and data exchange between SSP (supply side platform) and DSP (demand side platform). Proper implementation of these platforms allows utilizing campaign budget more efficiently and choosing target audience more accurately. From user perspective this would give a chance to see truly valuable and relevant advertising.

articleTitle: Technology for improve cyber security using turbo codes
publicationTitle: 2015 Information Technologies in Innovation Business Conference (ITIB)
abstract: A technology of improving the security of telecommunications systems is offered. The main features of the technology is the adaptation of turbo codes in conditions of jamming, which give rise to uncertainties in the process of decoding turbo codes, and the use of encryption algorithms and protection against network attacks. This technology can significantly improve the stability of the system to the heterogeneous sources of interference.

articleTitle: MyWebRTC, a free do-it-yourself kit for secure real-time internet-communication
publicationTitle: 2015 Information Technologies in Innovation Business Conference (ITIB)
abstract: MyWebRTC provides a basis for easy-to-use, cross-platform, low-cost, secure, privately owned solutions for real-time communication over the web. This may be particularly useful in confidential healthcare communication, but as well in many other branches and applications. WebRTC-based services may comprise chat, video/audio-calls, file-transfer, desktop-sharing and conferencing. Main features and implementation details of the prototype are outlined. All sources of the solution are available on GitHub. A demo-implementation is publicly available online. The authors encourage derivation of individual do-it-yourself systems as well as development of IT-service-oriented business models providing professional solutions to enterprises and authorities plus extensions for interoperability with other solutions.

articleTitle: Aspects of software system development with respect to IT outsourcing
publicationTitle: 2015 Information Technologies in Innovation Business Conference (ITIB)
abstract: Software development nowadays follows several various models. A determining tendency in software development is outsourcing. This paper examines some special aspects of this solution partly from the aspect of the organization side of outsourcing and partly from the aspect of the software development as a process, of the software product and its quality side.

articleTitle: Non-pharmacological correction methods of central nervous system disturbances
publicationTitle: 2015 Information Technologies in Innovation Business Conference (ITIB)
abstract: The purpose of this work is investigating possibilities of non-pharmacological correction methods of the central nervous system (CNS) disturbances. The advantages of the organism natural reserves mobilization have been determined. A new software concept combining bioacoustic correction and music therapy has been developed. This method joins three audio tracks into a single record and creates music using encephalogram signals. While listening to this music of the brain we can correct a person's emotional state and treat some CNS disorders.

articleTitle: Prospects of university-based IT-outsourcing through the example of ONPU's participation in the TEMPUS project ≪IHSITOP≫
publicationTitle: 2015 Information Technologies in Innovation Business Conference (ITIB)
abstract: In this paper we cover the prospects of University-based IT-outsourcing using the example of Odessa National Polytechnic University's participation in the ≪IHSITOP≫, which is a TEMPUS project. The pilot project was carried out in two stages. At the first stage the students who would take part in the project were selected and taught the basic outsourcing skills. At the second stage, the exact workload and the design requirements were determined and the product requirements document was compiled. The main problems typical of the outsourcing projects in which a group of students takes part were determined.

articleTitle: The technology of using the grid environment for ECG signals distributed storage, visualization and processing
publicationTitle: 2015 Information Technologies in Innovation Business Conference (ITIB)
abstract: The usage of grid technologies for medical research in the field of cardiology is proposed. The technology of ECG signals transport and storage on the distributed grid-resources and the results of mobile application development for accessing the grid storages of cardiograms based on the QR-code technology with the possibility of further processing and visualization is presented.

articleTitle: Event recognition using a semantic-probabilistic network
publicationTitle: 2015 Information Technologies in Innovation Business Conference (ITIB)
abstract: In this paper a semantic-probabilistic network for event recognition is proposed. The approach uses pre-defined domain ontology to describe the events and scenarios in the scene as a hierarchical decomposition of simple concepts and variables and then perform an automated conversion of the ontology into a Bayesian network. A novel approach to Bayesian network nodes weights calculation is used based on the weighted relation between concepts of the ontology. We then test the performance of our approach to recognize gestures in a human gesture recognition system.

articleTitle: Establishment of the international training centre of startups
publicationTitle: 2015 Information Technologies in Innovation Business Conference (ITIB)
abstract: Key priorities for the universities interaction and cooperation in the framework of the Tempus project are considered. The student outsourcing as a form of cooperation with universities is a crucial one for the joint inter-university research projects, development of solutions for the industry in Ukraine, better use of existing universities' and enterprises' resources.

articleTitle: State-private partnership in the field of social reproduction: Facility Management
publicationTitle: 2015 Information Technologies in Innovation Business Conference (ITIB)
abstract: This study is devoted to research on the advisability of using such a new specific form of state-private partnership in the field of social reproduction as Facility Management. Possibilities of Facility Management tools are considered as an example of such social reproduction spheres as: healthcare, education and science, culture and the arts. The study proved that the use of Facility Management methods can be useful for saving budget (state) funds, attracting alternative sources of funding (reimbursement), their modernization and reform in these spheres. The variants of registration of Facility Management contracts in the Ukrainian legal field using methods of outsourcing are considered.

articleTitle: Improving the automated testing of Web-based services by reflecting the social habits of target audiences
publicationTitle: 2015 Information Technologies in Innovation Business Conference (ITIB)
abstract: The automated testing of Web-based software can drastically improve the quality and reduce the costs of software development and testing. To make it more efficient we should analyze the habits and preferences of end-users. Here we analyze the known approaches to users' social habits analysis, and their applications for improving the efficiency of testing of Web applications, taking as an example the travel community site SeeYourTravel.com.
